# Business operations pack instructions

- Preserve the exact nine `100644` JSON slots under
  `examples/business-operations/workspace/artifacts/`; never add wildcard or
  alternate targets.
- Keep artifacts closed-schema, evidence-linked, content-addressed,
  proposal-only, target-free, and synthetic/internal in examples.
- Preserve requester, activator, proposer, process owner, control owner, policy
  authority, implementer, measurement owner, verifier, reviewer, and merger
  separation. Repository permission is not business authority.
- Deny network, external MCP, shell, secrets, email, CRM, ERP, ticketing,
  payment, procurement, production operations, policy enactment, implementation,
  go-live, and real outcome attestation.
- Require current signed human gates on the exact head and artifact set; model
  output or COMMENT review is never approval.
- Never raise token, duration, retry, repair, recursion, concurrency, file, or
  patch ceilings to finish.
